SYSTEM_DOKPLOY_ADVERTISE_ADDR.description: Address Docker Swarm advertises (default: the host's first IPv4 address)

SYSTEM_DOKPLOY_DOCKER_SWARM_INIT_ARGS.description: Extra 'docker swarm init' flags, e.g. --default-addr-pool 172.20.0.0/16 to avoid clashing with a VPC

SYSTEM_DOKPLOY_VERSION.description: Dokploy release tag to install (e.g. v0.26.6, canary); empty = latest stable
